The issuer shows solid operating profitability (EBIT of 2,672M on 8,055M revenue, ~33%) and substantial equity capitalization (shareholders’ equity 12,330M). However, liquidity is weak with current assets below current liabilities (current ratio ~0.79), and overall leverage is moderate (total liabilities 13,189M vs. equity 12,330M). This combination points to a lower investment-grade profile.

DECISION: BBB-
